summary_1line: Story of Richika marrying Satyavati, a ritual mix‑up altering future lineages, and the birth and upbringing of Jamadagni, father of Rama (Parashurama).

image_candidates.scene_text: Richika presents a thousand brown horses with single black ears that emerged from the Ganga as the bride price for Satyavati.
Satyavati and her mother mistakenly exchange the ritual pots of milk-rice and embrace the wrong sacred trees in the forest.
The sage Bhrigu confronts Satyavati, revealing the fateful mistake that will alter the destinies of their descendants.
